eeselis a popular Freddy AI alternative that connects directly to Freshdesk without requiring a platform switch. It resolves tickets, drafts replies, and handles escalations inside your existing Freshdesk setup on

a fixed monthly plan from $299/month for 500 credits(1 credit per ticket or chat) with no seat fees. Ada also integrates with Freshworks, though it is sold through a sales-led demo process aimed at enterprise contact volumes. See our full breakdown of

Freshdesk AI featuresfor context on what Freddy does natively.

### How much does Freddy AI cost compared to alternatives? [...] Pros: Pay-for-outcomes model instead of per-session billing. Wide channel coverage, including voice. Hands-on vendor team for deployment.

Cons: No public prices or self-serve trial. Freshdesk is not named on its product pages. Built for enterprise budgets and timelines.

Verdict: Worth a look for enterprise teams whose main issue with Freddy AI is paying per session rather than per result. For smaller Freshdesk teams it is likely more platform than they need.

## How to choose the right Freddy AI alternative

The decision comes down to one question: do you want to stay on Freshdesk, or are you open to switching?

Which Freddy AI alternative fits your team - a positioning guide [...] ### 4. Ada - best enterprise-grade standalone AI agent

Best for: Enterprise teams with large conversation volumes who want a dedicated AI layer on any helpdesk.

Ada is one of the few tools that genuinely replaces Freddy AI at the enterprise tier without requiring a Freshdesk migration. It integrates directly with Freshworks as a dedicated AI layer on top of your existing helpdesk. Toronto-headquartered and backed by ~$190M in funding including a $130M Series C at a $1.2B valuation led by Spark Capital in 2021, Ada has built the ACX Platform: a Reasoning Engine that orchestrates multiple LLMs, Playbooks for multi-step SOPs, and a Coaching model where reviewing AI conversations teaches the agent to improve automatically.
